title: fix(service-automation): audit inert connector descriptors on the metadata save door
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCpddLFmKzR39wJWZpkRMCi)_

Fixes #33839

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:管理员直接保存(PUT /api/v1/meta/connector/:name)一个带 actions、却没有运行时连接器的目录型 connector 描述时,日志立即给出"inert connector"告警;此前要等下一次发布或重启才会出现。
- 为什么改:原来告警只挂在启动和 metadata:reloaded 上,直接保存不触发这两者,配置了却跑不起来的连接器一直不被提示(PD#10:声明不等于交付,要大声说出来)。
- 风险与回滚:只改日志,不改任何接口返回。告警改为"惰性集合变化时才打印",同一集合不再在每次 reload 重复打印。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts` 的 `queueConnectorMutationReconcile`(新增审计调用)与 `auditDeclaredConnectors`(去重逻辑)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/connector-descriptor-audit.test.ts`,预期 14 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `queueConnectorMutationReconcile` (the `onMetadataMutation` path, which is the only signal a direct active save raises) now runs `auditDeclaredConnectors` after its reconcile, on the same reconcile queue, so the audit judges the registry that reconcile left.
- `auditDeclaredConnectors` remembers the inert set it last found (sorted names). It warns only when the set differs, and the warning still names the whole set. A publish raises both the mutation signal and `metadata:reloaded`, so it runs two audits; with this change it still prints one warning. Moving from a set to empty and back warns again. The audit also returns early once the plugin is destroyed, as the reconcile already does.
- Scope: the card asks for the audit "wherever the connector reconcile runs". The other reconcile callers (credential set/clear, connection connect/revoke, the boot-registered pass) do not change the declaration, and a catalog descriptor (no `provider`) is never made live by them, so they are left as they are. See Acceptance notes.

## Tests

`packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-descriptor-audit.test.ts` gains the top-level describe `[#33839] the audit on the metadata save door`. It runs on the real write path: ObjectKernel, ObjectQLPlugin's metadata protocol, and driver-sql on a temporary file. It waits for the audits the write queues to finish before it counts warnings.

- a direct active save of a catalog descriptor warns, naming it;
- a later publish of a second descriptor prints one more warning (not two), naming both;
- control: a re-save that leaves the inert set unchanged adds nothing; `enabled: false` empties it quietly; enabling it again warns again;
- control: a draft save runs no audit.

Ablations, run on the committed fix with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (each restored, `git diff HEAD` empty, blob equal to HEAD):

- A: drop the audit call from the mutation path. Result: 3 failed, 11 passed (`expected 0 to be greater than or equal to 1`).
- B: drop the dedupe (`|| unchanged`). Result: 2 failed, 12 passed (`expected [ …(3) ] to have a length of 2 but got 3`; `… length of 1 but got 2`).

## Acceptance notes

- Read cost: each connector mutation now adds one audit. That is one read of the declaration, the same `readDeclaredConnectorItems({ post: true })` read the reload audit makes. Mutations are coalesced, so a burst of saves reported before the queued run starts costs one reconcile and one audit. Connector saves are rare admin writes.
- Behaviour change, log only: before this change every `metadata:reloaded` printed the warning again, even when the inert set had not changed. Now it is printed when the set changes. The checklist item `integration-system.connector-descriptor-audit` acceptance[2] ("the audit re-runs on metadata reload … enabling the scratch descriptor at runtime surfaces the warning without a restart") still holds, because enabling a descriptor changes the set. Its `automated.ref` says no pin drives a non-boot path; the new describe drives the mutation path (save and publish). `docs/qa/**` is outside this PR's file surface, so it is not edited here.
- A peer replica that hears the mutation over lane 2 also audits and logs its own view. That is the same reach the reconcile already has.
